purpose: Detail close-ups showing button texture, LED diffusion, material junction, and charging contacts
prompt:
Industrial design detail close-up sheet for an elderly AI companion device, showing macro-level material and connection details. Warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

Show 4 detail close-ups arranged in a 2x2 grid, each framed in a rounded rectangle with soft warm shadow:

Detail 1 (top-left): "Button Surface Texture" — Extreme close-up of the large 25mm button on the front face. The button surface is warm gray (#D4CFC7) soft-touch matte with a very fine concentric circle texture (subtle tactile ridges for finger positioning). The edge where button meets the cream fabric body is a smooth G2 continuous transition — no visible gap or seam. Warm side lighting reveals the subtle texture.

Detail 2 (top-right): "LED Light Diffusion" — Close-up of the amber LED ring (#E8B87A) glowing through the translucent fabric/diffuser material. The light is perfectly even — no hot spots, no visible individual LED dots. The glow fades softly from the ring center outward with a Gaussian falloff. The surrounding cream fabric picks up a warm amber tint near the light. Looks like warm candlelight.

Detail 3 (bottom-left): "Fabric-to-Plastic Junction" — Macro view of where the cream fabric wrap (#F5F0E8) meets the light oak wood base (#C4A882). The transition is smooth and seamless — the fabric tucks under the wood edge with a gentle curve, no sharp parting line, no visible adhesive. The wood grain is visible with open-pore finish.

Detail 4 (bottom-right): "Charging Contacts" — Bottom view showing the magnetic charging contacts hidden on the underside of the wood base. Two small gold-plated pogo-pin contacts flush with the wood surface, surrounded by a subtle circular alignment ring. The wood grain continues over the contact area. Clean, hidden design — technology invisible unless you turn the device upside down.

All details photographed in warm 2700K lighting with shallow depth of field. Photorealistic macro photography quality. Warm, tactile, premium craft aesthetic.
